title: Long-Range Distillation: Distilling 10,000 Years of Simulated Climate into Long Timestep AI Weather Models
abstract: arXiv:2512.22814v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Accurate long-range weather forecasting remains a major challenge for AI models, both because errors accumulate over autoregressive rollouts and because reanalysis training datasets provide limited sampling of the slow modes of variability underpinning predictability. Most AI and all numerical weather prediction models are autoregressive, repeatedly applying short-lead forecasts to reach subseasonal-to-seasonal (S2S) or seasonal lead times, often causing instability and miscalibration. Long-timestep probabilistic models that generate long-range forecasts in a single step offer an alternative, but training on the 40-year reanalysis record leads to overfitting, suggesting orders of magnitude more data are required. We introduce long-range distillation, whereby a long-timestep probabilistic ``student'' model is trained to forecast directly at long-range using a huge synthetic dataset generated by an autoregressive ``teacher'' model. translated_title: 远程蒸馏：将一万年模拟气候蒸馏进长时间步长的AI天气模型
translated_abstract: 准确的长期天气预报对AI模型而言仍是一项重大挑战，原因在于误差会在自回归滚动预测中不断累积，且再分析训练数据集对支撑可预报性的慢变率模态的采样十分有限。大多数AI模型以及所有数值天气预报模型都是自回归式的，需要反复应用短时效预报才能达到次季节至季节（S2S）乃至季节性预报时效，这常常导致不稳定和校准失准。能够在单步中生成长期预报的长步长概率模型提供了一种替代方案，但仅基于40年的再分析记录进行训练会导致过拟合，这表明需要比现有数据多出几个数量级的数据量。我们提出了远程蒸馏方法：利用一个自回归“教师”模型生成的海量合成数据集，来训练一个长步长概率“学生”模型直接进行长期预报。
tldr: 提出了一种“远程蒸馏”方法，利用自回归教师模型生成的一万年模拟气候合成数据，训练单步生成的长时间步长概率学生模型，从而解决AI长期天气预报中误差累积与再分析数据不足导致的过拟合问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "long-range distillation," which trains a long-timestep probabilistic student model to make single-step long-range weather forecasts using a massive 10,000-year synthetic climate dataset generated by an autoregressive teacher model, overcoming error accumulation and overfitting in AI long-range weather prediction.
